procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/jefferson/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (12/12).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 12); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 12 precincts (11 columns, then Union Church + TOTAL), precinct names printed ALL-CAPS carried verbatim; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the Chancery 4 Place 3 continuation row and the locals. The SEMS row-block split repeats the Adams pattern: Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 3's section carries TWO candidates -- Debbra K. Halford's row completes table A (under the Place 3 header) and Ashunda Hampton's row starts p4 ahead of the local zone with no header repeat (the third county printing the split identically). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller, Bennie G. Thompson, Bennie Foster -- the same House 2 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald); Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 1 (E. Vincent Davis), Place 2 (Wayne Smith), Place 3 (Debbra K. Halford, Ashunda Hampton) -- the same Chancery 4 roster Adams and Franklin print, names identical; 'Circuit Court 7-5-Circuit Court 7-5' (the sheet's own label form, the same as Claiborne's) with Tomika T. Harris-Irving -- the same Circuit 7-5 roster Claiborne prints, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 2695, Hyde-Smith 366, Pinkins 30, Eller 344, G. Thompson 2686, Foster 54, McDonald 2824, E. Vincent Davis 2844, Wayne Smith 2662, Halford 1306, Hampton 1553, Tomika T. Harris-Irving 2878.
operator_rows_note: All 12 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (the Union Church cell + printed TOTAL); Hampton's and Harris-Irving's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twelve precinct headers print complete in the sheet's ALL-CAPS forms (CANNONSBURG, CHURCH HILL, CITY HALL, HARRISTON, LOCUST GROVE BAPTIST CHURCH, LORMAN, MT. ISREAL BAPTIST CHURCH, MULTIPURPOSE CENTER, OLD HEADSTART BUILDING, RED LICK, STAMPLEY, UNION CHURCH -- kept verbatim, 'Mt. Isreal' the sheet's own spelling).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 7-5: School Board District 5-School Board Member (Orisha Brown-Mims, Elisa Wells Jackson, Patricia West, Orlando 'Maurice' Williams) and District 02-Election Commissioner (Errol Tyrone Pierce) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 4's three Places print in-county (labels matching the other Chancery 4 counties); the Circuit 7-5 single printed seat keeps the bare 'Circuit Court' label district 7 (matching Claiborne's).
